findings.detail: Modern continuous long now uses200 resolved locks at density1, retaining12x5 lock and48x32 curtain tessellation. Original1,718,688-byte R1 head-only case is now1,565,088. Maximum valid length/strand-width/curvature/wave/full-beard at each integer texture position also fits full fallback heads at1,640,608 bytes. Five densities match round(200*density); categorical legacy and other modern styles retain prior count/geometry.

Refreshed four texture originals show broader, shorter curl/coily envelopes at fixed person, with especially visible profile differences. Straight/wavy differences remain modest. Reduced lock count causes no material new visible regression in these selected images.

56 categorical legacy meshes and1,700 non-hair parts match the frozen before exactly. Eight focused checks also preserve other modern styles and real snapshot identity. Actual dossier and both built named replacement/load/reload receipts are primary-executed integration evidence; inspected actual OL dossier is not a newly groomed long-hair persistence proof.

Profile curtains remain fabric-like, dangling ends sparse, and lock/tip coherence incomplete. Faces and body remain simplified/mannequin. Envelope differentiation does not establish true curl geometry, population calibration or complete player acceptance.
